description: Agent Readiness: submit a task an agent must pay for (amount, counterparty type, whether it requires a refund path, whether a party other than the payer must carry loss) and the money options available with their stated properties (kind such as stablecoin, tokenized deposit or agent card, reversibility, refund path, redemption, who carries loss, limits, accepted by, fee). The signed report names the option that fits and why, each option ruled out with the property that rules it out (irreversible where a refund path is required, redemption risk, liability mismatch, limits, acceptance), and every property the material leaves unstated. Payment rails are wever_payment-rail-check. Verdict no_option_fits, fit_unconfirmed or fit_found. POST /api/money-fit-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.
